visualCharacteristics: Lead column pulled over the hero band with category pill links, the page title and a white availability-check card with customer-type switch, postcode/house-number fields, business checkbox and check button.
contentPattern:
Content-classified:
    of links = category pills;

    = page title;

    /

    = card title;
      without links = customer-type switch;
        = address field labels;

        (no link) = check button; other

usage: Use directly under the hero on program and landing pages to let visitors check product availability at their address.
reuseGuidance: Reuse wherever an address availability check is needed; use inline when it sits in the page flow rather than over a hero.
